approaches.name: extend-existing-llm-chat-and-ingest
approaches.summary: Keep the one shared LlmChat component and the one /chat/stream endpoint; add a 'rules' PromptKey for matching-rule refinement and restyle through shared tokens. Route failed-receipt uploads through the existing intake ingest() as SourceKind.MANUAL with a new multipart router. Dashboard built from KpiCard and the existing shadcn chart.tsx.
how: Add 'rules' to PromptKey and a systemPromptKey/actions map in the chat service; no new chat component.

Restyle llm-chat.tsx and llm-chat/* parts (composer, message-list, action-chips) with dark tokens in globals.css, borrowing AIX look (chips row, activity group, header pill) as new parts inside components/common/llm-chat/.

New api/src/cashapp/api/routers/receipt_review.py: multipart UploadFile list (python-multipart already pinned), store bytes via ObjectStoreDep, call pollers/intake/ingest.ingest() with SourceKind.MANUAL and a batch_id.
Next proxy route for the upload; review result read from existing items/[id] view.
Progress dashboard: KpiCard for counts/money, recharts via components/ui/chart.tsx, per-model efficiency from llm_usage.py daily and cohere-utilisation endpoints.
evidence: web/components/common/llm-chat.tsx:17-27 (LlmChatProps: context, systemPromptKey, actions, onAction, variant; already configured by props)
web/components/ui/chart.tsx and web/components/reports/failures-by-code-chart.tsx (existing recharts wrapper to reuse)
api/pyproject.toml:25 (python-multipart already a dependency, no UploadFile use yet)
api/src/cashapp/api/routers/llm_usage.py:37-67 (daily usage and cohere-utilisation for model efficiency)
risks: Adding a 'rules' prompt key touches the chat service and its allow-list; keep the single endpoint and do not add a second chat path.
Multipart upload needs size limits and content sniffing (sniff.py exists) before storage; zero-retention and no raw artifact logging apply.
Per-model accuracy and adjudicator agreement may need new aggregate queries; those belong in a repository, not the router.
Restyling shared llm-chat parts changes existing item and flow chats; verify visually on both.

approaches.name: port-aix-chat-wholesale
approaches.summary: Copy the AIX-Payroll-Compare chat feature (thread, composer chips, header pills, markdown, code-block parts) into web/ as the assistant, replacing or sitting beside the existing llm-chat.
how: Copy src/features/chat/ui/thread, composer and activity trees from D:\AIX-Payroll-Compare\webapp.
Adapt its conversation API and turn/stream code to the cashapp /chat/stream contract.
Mount it as the single assistant surface in the shell.
Keep existing llm-chat only for item and flow contexts, or retire it.
evidence: web/components/common/llm-chat.tsx (existing shared chat that already covers the same job)
risks: Duplicates the shared llm-chat component, which violates CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 7 (one chat component).
AIX chat is coupled to its own conversation store, proposals and plugins; large porting surface with little reuse of the cashapp backend.
Imports from AIX would bring its tests and e2e assumptions; much of it is out of scope for a rules-refinement chat.

approaches.name: adopt-npm-chat-runtime
approaches.summary: Replace the hand-rolled SSE chat state (use-chat.ts, chat-reducer.ts) with an npm chat runtime such as @assistant-ui/react, keeping the shared component as a thin wrapper around it.
how: Install @assistant-ui/react (0.15.31) or @ai-sdk/react (4.0.155); write one custom adapter to POST /chat/stream and parse its SSE frames.
Wrap it in components/common/llm-chat.tsx so props stay the public contract.
Use its thread and composer primitives styled with the dark tokens.
Keep the upload and dashboard work from approach 1 unchanged.
evidence: web/components/common/llm-chat/use-chat.ts and chat-reducer.ts (existing SSE state machine that a library would replace)
web/package.json: cmdk, react-markdown, recharts, sonner already present (no chat runtime yet)
risks: New dependency that owns streaming, retries and message state; the existing error and disconnected phases (chat-status.tsx) and the stream-error frame contract would need a custom adapter.
Version churn risk: pre-1.0 package (0.15.x), and the AI SDK major is 4.x; both need the two-week-old rule checked at pin time.
Could end up as a second chat implementation if the wrapper is not strict, breaking the single-component rule.
